rules.statement: A co-owner desiring to sell his share of land must give reasonable notice to other co-owners according to the times specified in the first paragraph of section 7 of the Tesavalamai.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think we must hold that reasonable notice must be given. It certainly is desirable that, in order to prevent dispute as to notice and consequent litigation, some definite formality should be prescribed by the Legislature if the right of pre-emption itself is not taken away."
